entities.name: Murder of Ankita Bhandari
entities.label: Idea
entities.summary: Ankita Bhandari was an Indian receptionist from Pauri who was murdered at the Vanantra Resort by its owner Pulkit Arya, the son of senior Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) leader Vinod Arya in Ganga-Bhogpur in Rishikesh, Uttarakhand. BJP MLA Renu Bisht is accused of attempting to cover up the crime by having ordered an unlawful demolition of the resort after the murder.
